items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: He, he, uh, all I knew him, he never did play with no other band, but he, he was a good little drummer.

ctx.x: Uh. Not, well let me name some drummer, see if you know him. D.D. Channel was from uptown, huh? No. Mac Murray? No. Uh, Willigans? No. Wasn't that guy named Tillman?
Uh. You're kind of running out of uptown drummer from uptown. Uh, hmm.
